statement: The proportion of SUID cases with hospital overnight stays is higher compared to the weighted prevalence among PRAMS mothers in 2008-2019.
rationale: This design compares the proportion of SUID cases that had hospital overnight stays (from NCFRP_v51) with the weighted prevalence of similar hospital stays among PRAMS mothers (PRAMS_P8_ARF).
prior_art: None in the inputs. The role of short-term hospital admissions as a risk factor for SUID is understudied, making this question relevant and open.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or temporal relationships between hospital overnight stays and SUID incidence. It can only compare proportions of mothers who had babies admitted to hospital overnight stays in the case series versus the population reference.
